title: Clocked write of unsigned(<slice>) driving sync-ROM addr (P2A LOAD shape)
sourceUrl: internal: P2A CPU LOAD pipeline regression
license: internal regression test, no external reference
problemDescription: Mirrors P2A's S_EXEC_LOAD_ADDR -> S_EXEC_LOAD_FETCH -> S_EXEC_LOAD_WRITE pipeline. On go, sample word's low byte into mar_reg via `mar_reg <= unsigned(word(7 downto 0))`, wait one cycle for the sync ROM, then capture rom_data into data_reg. Expected: data settles to the ROM slot whose address equals word's low byte. Tests slice-LHS in unsigned cast + clocked-write -> concurrent -> sync-ROM-read chain.
